label.description: The label to show on the threshold. This can be a translation key.

value.description:
The y value at which to show the threshold, used when the threshold is a constant value.

**NOTE**: This has priority over #start and #end if all three are provided.

start.description:
The y **start** value at which to show the threshold, used together with #end.

**NOTE**: Used when the threshold is not a constant line, but starts at a specific value and ends at another.

end.description:
The y **end** value at which to show the threshold, used together with #start.

**NOTE**: This field is required if #start is provided.

title:
Represents a threshold for the {@link UiApTimeseriesChart}.
This is used to plot a horizontal line in the chart at a specific value.
name: UiApTimeseriesChartTsThreshold
